meta.title: Books
meta.description: Read and manage your book library inside DeepSeek Harness

empty: No books found. Add TXT/EPUB/PDF/AZW3/DOC/DOCX files to your library folder.
noText: This book has no extractable text (it may be a scanned image PDF or DRM-protected).
importHint: Click the button below to choose book files (multiple allowed); they will be copied into the library folder
setPathHint: Change where books are stored. Check "move existing books" to also move files from the current folder.
moveExisting: Move existing books to new location
moveNote: Files with the same name already at the target are skipped; cross-volume moves fall back to copy + delete.
pickFailed: Could not open the folder picker
scannedHint: This is a scanned PDF ({n} pages) with no text layer. Page-by-page image view is enabled: you can flip and zoom, but text cannot be searched or copied.
categoryHint: Custom categories are managed by you; 📁 categories are generated from folders in the library.
arrowHint: Tip: press ← / → to flip pages while reading.
deleteRecord: Remove from shelf only (keep local file)
deleteRecordNote: The book disappears from the shelf but the file stays in the library folder; you can re-import it anytime.
deleteFile: Remove from shelf and delete local file
deleteFileNote: Both the shelf record and the file in the library folder are permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
deleteWarn: This cannot be undone; please choose carefully.
